criteria.original: Deliver a helper result from a background queue and assert callback main thread and matching status.
criteria.evidence: Real Darwin background completion and main run loop; public callback asserts NSThread.isMainThread plus Granted/Denied status and lastRequest before application invocation. Duplicate completion produces exactly one callback.

criteria.original: Dispose while native prompt remains active; no stale UI callback/state publication.
criteria.evidence: Registered native-interface request and query remain pending across actual Composition/Lifecycle disposal; late real background completions publish neither callback nor status/details and cannot initiate a native query. Zero observers and one helper disposal.
criteria.scope: Controlled still-pending native-interface helper, not OS privacy-dialog interaction or native UI dismissal. The owning controller suppresses callbacks; it does not promise to cancel Apple privacy UI.

criteria.original: Throw from user callback and verify cleanup/status recovery; race two asynchronous status queries.
criteria.evidence: Exact application exception surfaces once; same public owner accepts another request without constructing a replacement helper. Newer granted query beats older denied query. Three new common Job regressions additionally verify throwing disposal still releases its job and parent cancellation still suppresses all work.

public_compatibility: Existing PermissionState/MutablePermissionState/PermissionHelper identities and callback descriptors remain; operation scope is an internal ownership repair. No public ABI or release certification.
historical_remaining_before_this_verific: Real Apple queue/runloop/scene teardown tests pending; injected backend tests do not emulate OS prompts.
Apple authorization UI cannot generally be dismissed; disposal suppresses library callbacks, not native UI.
